verdict.rationale: Docs claim Workers 'fits into your existing workflows: Git, GitHub Actions... any framework' and mention a dedicated 'Workers Builds' MCP surface, implying git-connected CI/CD deploys exist, and deployments/rollbacks are managed via Wrangler or the dashboard. However there is no detailed first-party walkthrough of connecting a repo with automatic framework/build detection (the zero-config aspect), and no independent/community confirmation of a no-manual-config git-to-deploy flow. Missing for 10: explicit repo-connect + auto build-detection docs, hands-on/community confirmation that no manual build config is needed, and comparison to how framework presets are auto-selected.
